description: Agent Food Safety Records: submit temperature and critical-control-point monitoring logs with the plan limits and equipment they answer to: the unit the records state degrees in (F or C); each limit the plan states with its id, the critical control point, the product the plan monitors there, the lowest and highest readings allowed and the hours allowed between readings; each unit in the facility record with its id, reference, name and the control point the plan assigns it; each temperature log entry with its id, reference, the equipment, the control point logged, the product logged, the moment read and the reading; each corrective action with its id, reference, the log entry it answers and the moment recorded. The signed report gives the readings and the limits, each reading against the limit for its control point and a corrective action behind any reading outside it, each control point’s log against the interval the plan states, each unit in the facility record against a temperature log behind it, and each log entry’s control point and product against the plan’s, and counts them, and names divergent temperature log records: a reading outside the limit the plan states recorded with no corrective action behind it, a gap in the log across a period the stated schedule requires readings, equipment in the facility record with no temperature log behind it, and a log entry whose recorded product or control point differs from the plan’s; then a corrective action naming a log entry the records do not hold and a log entry naming equipment the facility record does not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No readings, readings with no plan limits beside them, or a logged control point with no limit leaves those points unverified. Log entries, units, control points and actions match by letters and digits, a reading reads under the control point it logs or the one its unit carries, readings compare with the limit in the stated unit, a gap runs between consecutive dated readings of one control point, on the clock when both carry a time, and products compare by their words without case or punctuation. This reads whether every reading stayed inside the plan’s limits on schedule, and every out-of-limit reading was answered. Verdict food_temperature_divergent, food_temperature_partial, food_temperature_unverified or food_temperature_consistent. POST /api/food-temperature-check. Reads the food safety records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it inspects no facility, takes no temperature, contacts no regulator or auditor and issues no certification, which stay with the business, its food safety team, its regulators and its auditors, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Food Safety Records reads a food business’s own safety records: food safety and HACCP plan records, critical-control-point and temperature monitoring logs, health inspection and third-party audit reports, recall and traceability records, supplier approval and receiving records, sanitation records, allergen and labeling records and corrective action records, each against the monitoring, inspection and corrective-action records, the corrective actions and the schedule, the plan’s limits and equipment, the lot traceability and inventory records, the supplier approvals and certificates, the cleaning schedule and safety data sheets, the formulation and production records or the deviations and verifications on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the food: what the plan requires, what the logs show, what the inspectors found, and whether the fixes and the traceability hold up; the Agent Customs Records family reads the border filings for goods as trade records, and the Agent Automotive family reads vehicle records, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-food-safety-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-food-safety-records/.
